tool_notes.news_search: Only when a part has a gap in the source: write up to 3 English keywords at a time that fill that gap. per_keyword is the number of articles per keyword (default 3, at most 5). The same article does not come back again. Read the results before you upload.
tool_notes.source_get: Use it only for the source document. Open the part by its address (fs://source/<number>#<part>) to check a sentence you quote in evidence.
tool_notes.source_query: When the part that holds a concept is hard to find in the map, ask one short, specific question. Write the sentence and the address you get back in evidence.
tool_notes.theory_upload: Upload only the 2–3 articles that fill the gap. file = the file news_search returned, title = article title, source = article URL. Use the fs://theory/<number> you get back as the address in evidence. Only the articles you cite in evidence go on to the story planner (all uploaded ones if you cite none).
tool_notes.theory_get: Use it to read an article you uploaded again. Put the address fs://theory/<number> in as is.

part_id.description: the id of the producer's part this item covers, copied from the brief as is (p1, p2, ...)

analogy.description: an analogy; an empty string if no analogy fits the facts

misunderstanding.description: a common misunderstanding of this concept; an empty string if none really fits

gap.description: for an article (fs://theory/...): in one sentence, what this article fills that the source lacks; leave it empty for the source document
